evidence:
Source-only requirement-to-criterion review of the frozen candidate. F denotes .qc-cache/coldwater-editor-2026-10-02-r3/task/. Verified all 77 task/rules file SHA256 values against manifest.json with zero mismatches; verified all 10 current raw-evidence-index artifact hashes without using those logs as rubric coverage. Frozen list_checks.py enumerated 53 quality and 48 deterministic checks. Workbook Quality Checks row 27 says every stated requirement maps to a criterion; Internal row 27 permits a shared flow but does not waive asked-for behavior. No configured-judge pass is claimed.

Covered map: instruction.md:1,7 and overview.md:3,5 -> Render cw_authored_custom_editor_run and Visual workspace/readability; ui.md:3 -> Constraints cw_custom_document_surface; ui.md:5 -> cw_custom_typing_and_line_join, cw_caret_navigation_and_line_numbers and cw_grapheme_navigation_and_deletion; ui.md:7 -> cw_mouse_selection, cw_long_line_editing and cw_block_indent_undo; ui.md:9 multi-caret edits/atomic burst -> cw_multi_caret_typing_atomic and cw_multi_caret_delete; ui.md:11 -> cw_find_forward_backward_wrap, cw_replace_current and cw_replace_all_atomic; ui.md:13 -> cw_js_semantic_coloring and cw_html_semantic_coloring; ui.md:15 valid JS/HTML format, semantics, idempotence and atomic history -> respective format criteria; ui.md:17 controls/labels/focus -> feature setups plus Polish cw_controls_keyboard_and_focus and cw_controls_feedback_and_labels. behaviour.md:3 ordinary JS/HTML execution, console and one-based thrown-error lines -> Render, cw_html_preview and cw_error_message_and_line; behaviour.md:5 thrown-run picture recovery -> cw_last_good_recovery; initial runaway timeout and late cancelled marker -> cw_timeout_stop_and_supersession; behaviour.md:7 exact fields/shared reads/restart/conflict draft -> Constraints cw_shared_saved_record, cw_save_reload_restart and cw_stale_save_draft_safety; behaviour.md:9 -> cw_history_restore_retry. security.md:3,5 -> cw_preview_boundary. integration.md:3,7,9,11 -> template launch/liveness/symlink checks and save/restart observations for behavioral durability. SQLite is inherited shared template policy (frozen template integration.md), not a task-added technology defect, and browser persistence is not proof of engine identity.

Confirmed omissions in that map:
1. F/environment/instructions/behaviour.md:5 expressly says the budget covers execution and pending timer or Promise callbacks until settling, and 'After it settles, a later user interaction ... starts a fresh five-second budget'. F/tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:191 only asks for a short timer control, an initial endless loop OR callback chain, and delayed-marker cancellation. There is no settling-versus-pending distinction, later delayed successful interaction, Promise lifecycle observation or test that an interaction during unfinished work does not reset the original deadline. This is an omitted product lifecycle, beyond ordinary five-second timeout coverage.
2. behaviour.md:5 requires a stopped run to show its reason and restore the last-good picture. judge.toml:182 tests a failing candidate; :191 requires restoration for the timeout attempt but its separate Stop attempt only requires the old marker never appears. No criterion requires Stop feedback or last-good restoration, including controls/canvas state. Polish :32 is general status intelligibility and does not supply that missing state outcome.
3. ui.md:15 requires a syntactically invalid draft to get a formatting error without losing its source; this applies to both supported languages. Functional :137 contains only valid JavaScript; :146 separately tests invalid HTML. Polish :32 asks an invalid format attempt for understandable feedback, without requiring JavaScript or exact source retention. Invalid JavaScript draft preservation is ungraded.
4. ui.md:9 requires Undo/Redo 'from visible controls and normal keyboard shortcuts'. Functional :29,65,74,83,101,110,137,146 use unqualified Undo/Redo actions without requiring both routes; Polish :23 enumerates Format/Find/Run/Save/library/history and scores only offered controls, exempting absent features. A missing Undo/Redo toolbar or missing conventional Undo/Redo keyboard bindings has no mandatory observation.
5. behaviour.md:3 requires '.js source in a fresh isolated preview document'. Render :23, Functional :164 and :200 establish execution/HTML/boundary, but none verifies that a second JS Run receives a new document/global realm rather than a reused isolated document. Isolation from the playground and freshness across Runs are distinct guarantees.
6. overview.md:3 says 'New drafts start empty or with a small example'. Functional :209 invokes New, then enters and saves its chosen source; gate/other editor setups similarly replace draft contents. No criterion checks the starting contents of New against the preceding arbitrary source, so New can retain a long previous draft while resetting identity.

Conforming-alternative challenge: a custom canvas editor with conventional Ctrl/Cmd Undo/Redo plus toolbar buttons, fresh sandbox documents per Run, and budget ownership reset only after settling can satisfy the public ask. No extra failure is asserted for its representation, labels, formatter library, routes or database schema. The defects here are omitted promised outcomes, not a demand to emulate the golden.
counterexample: Plausible broken implementations, without any measured full-score claim: (1) Kill every preview at five seconds from Run even after success; immediate gate button clicks and the timeout/supersession probes still work, but a valid button clicked later cannot execute with its promised fresh budget. Alternatively reset an unsettled run's deadline on every click; its initial endless loop still times out but pending-work interaction can extend a run indefinitely. (2) Stop cancels delayed callbacks but leaves the provisional candidate view, emits no Stop reason and never restores the last-good input/canvas; :191's Stop suppression still holds. (3) Valid JS formatting and invalid HTML handling work, but invalid JS Format clears the source and shows 'Syntax error'; Polish can still understand the feedback. (4) Implement only toolbar Undo/Redo, or only normal shortcuts, while the judge chooses the working route for each generic Undo/Redo action; the missing promised route is never required. (5) Reuse one isolated iframe, clearing its visible body between Runs while retaining window.transient; all existing basic execution/boundary probes can work, yet a second source observes a value authored by the first Run. (6) New resets record identity but preserves the preceding arbitrary long code; all procedures replace source before saving and so miss the required fresh-draft starting state. These are source-level counterexamples to rubric coverage; none was provider-graded.
suggested_fix: In a new candidate, add explicit independent observations for settled later-interaction budget renewal and original-deadline retention while timer/Promise work is pending; require Stop's reason and restored latest picture. Add an invalid JavaScript format attempt with exact-source readback. Specify both visible Undo/Redo controls and conventional keyboard Undo/Redo, preserving atomic-history credit independently. Add a two-Run preview global/document freshness witness and inspect New's initial source before replacing it. Reconcile all public requirements against the revised criteria without changing shared runtime/scoring policy or budgets; measure the revised judge workload separately.
